|ingredients = {{Name|Eggplant|1}}{{Name|Tomato|1}} }} '''Eggplant Parmesan''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. '''Note''': this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will always result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients. Eggplant Parmesan may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. It is also sold by the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] and in [[Gus]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s and {{Price|30|calico}} Calico Eggs, respectively. One Eggplant Parmesan may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |love=Jodi |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Eggplant Parmesan is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Eggplant Parmesan is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt114.png|24px]] It can be also used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Eggplant Parmesan is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trivia== Despite Parmesan being a kind of cheese, and the dish being described as 'cheesy', the recipe does not actually call for [[Cheese]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].}} {{History|1.6|Can now be purchased from Gus at the Desert Festival.}} {{NavboxRecipes}} [[Category:Recipes]] [[Category:Cooking]] [[de:Auberginen-Parmesan]] [[es:Berenjena al parmesano]] [[fr:Aubergine au parmesan]] [[it:Parmigiana]] [[ja:ナスのチーズ焼き]] [[ko:가지 파마산]] [[hu:Padlizsán parmezán]] [[pt:Parmesão com berinjela]] [[ru:Баклажаны с пармезаном]] [[tr:Parmesanlı Patlıcan]] [[zh:帕尔玛奶酪茄子]]
